brief:
Israel dropped "skunk water"—a foul-smelling liquid irritant—on Gaza this week, according to Zeteo. The substance, used by Israeli forces as a crowd-control measure, was deployed amid ongoing military operations in the territory.

In the West Bank, Israeli authorities demolished Palestinian homes as part of what rights groups characterize as systematic displacement policies. The demolitions continued as Israel's military campaign in Gaza persists.
dek: Zeteo’s weekly round-up of the stories you may have missed out of occupied Gaza and the West Bank, as Israel continues its genocidal war and apartheid policies.
title: Israel deploys skunk water in Gaza, demolishes West Bank homes
